title: Chessboard Trembles
next_chapter_hook: At the moment the Tianji Sword resonated, an ancient mark sealed for a millennium slowly emerged on Chen Ji's brow center—the existence that slumbered for a thousand years was awakening.

text.content:
The Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, the night as black as ink.

Chen Ji sat cross-legged in the cliffside cave dwelling, Spiritual Energy surging around him like a tide. The Profound Gate he had just broken through had yet to fully stabilize, while his Dantian churned like a storm-tossed sea. At his brow center, a fractured Jade Slip emanated a faint glow—the Tianji Record Fragment, bound tightly to his divine soul.

Yet just then, a formless fluctuation spread from the depths of the Void.

The fluctuation was silent and invisible, yet carried an asphyxiating pressure, as if an invisible giant hand was slowly reaching down from beyond the endless firmament, intending to grasp the entire world in its palm.

dialogue.content:
"Found you."

A voice of extreme coldness resounded directly in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, bypassing his eardrums, without utilizing Spiritual Energy—acting directly upon the depths of his divine soul. The voice was indifferent to the point of cruelty, as if stating an insignificant fact.

"A chess piece, after all, is merely a chess piece."

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

As the bearer of the Tianji Record, his perception of fate far exceeded ordinary people. Yet at this moment, that wave of consciousness brought him an unprecedented sense of suffocation—not Spiritual Pressure, not killing intent, but an existence itself that transcended comprehension.

It was as if above him, a pair of eyes gazed down upon the entire chessboard, while he was merely an insignificant piece upon it.

The master of that voice, if willing, could erase him from the board at any moment.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the trembling in his heart, and even managed a cold smile at the corners of his lips.

"The ultimate chess player... Cang Yutian."

He spoke word by word, his voice echoing in his Mental Sea: "I have been waiting for you for a long time."

text.content:
No sooner had the words fallen than the pressure in the Void suddenly intensified more than tenfold.

Chen Ji felt as though an invisible hand was gripping his Mental Sea tightly, each thought becoming incomparably difficult. That wave of consciousness was like a materialized mountain, crushing down layer upon layer, intending to crush his divine soul completely.

Blood seeped from his seven orifices, his bones creaking under the immense pressure.

Yet at this critical moment, the Tianji Sword that had lain dormant within him for years suddenly resonated with a sharp sound!

"Clang—"

The clear, melodious sword cry resounded throughout the cave dwelling. The Tianji Sword, which had been lying dormant in Chen Ji's Dantian, now broke free from its restraints on its own, transforming into a streak of light and shooting out of his body.

The mottled cracks on the blade were now emanating a faint bronze glow, and ancient runes appeared on the sword's surface, like a slumbering giant opening its eyes.

At the same time, the Tianji Record Fragment at Chen Ji's brow center began to vibrate violently, releasing a warm force that resonated with the Tianji Sword's glow.

In the Mental Sea, that cold voice showed the first slight fluctuation.

"This is..."

The voice paused, as if examining something. After a moment, a low sneer rang out: "So that's it. The Tianji Sword... and the residual soul of that one. No wonder you could reach this point."

For the first time, a hint of genuine interest appeared in the tone: "Interesting. A piece that thinks it is the one setting the board, actually carries something even I failed to detect."

Chen Ji felt the consciousness pressure suddenly triple, yet at the same time, the nascent power within him flowed rapidly, interweaving with the Tianji Sword's runes to form a strange barrier. Covered in blood, he stood perfectly straight.

In the Mental Sea, a thought ran wild: This was the first time he was facing the legendary ultimate chess player—the本体意识 of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. At this moment, he had to make a choice.

choice.prompt: How would Chen Ji respond to this pressure from a chess player that transcended all comprehension?

choices.description: Using the Tianji Sword as a conduit, directly counter this consciousness pressure, displaying an unyielding will
choices.visible_reward: May uncover secrets about the Tianji Sword
choices.risk_hint: If defeated, the divine soul may suffer irreversible damage

text.content:
Chen Ji gritted his teeth tightly, the Tianji Sword trembling violently in his palm. He poured all his divine consciousness into the blade, and a bronze-colored sword light shot skyward, directly meeting that invisible hand!

"A mere consciousness suppression—" his voice exploded in the Mental Sea, "I, Chen Ji, never submit to fate!"

The instant the sword light collided with that consciousness, Chen Ji felt his divine soul torn into millions of fragments. The intense pain almost made him lose consciousness, but he bit down hard on his tongue, using the pain to forcibly maintain clarity. In that chaos, he glimpsed something—countless intertwined threads of fate, and a giant eye woven from the laws of Heavenly Secrets.

choices.description: Suppress one's aura, using the Tianji Record Fragment to conceal oneself, avoiding consciousness detection
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance to understand the opponent
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, avoid revealing one's trump cards
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as cowardice, the opponent will despise even more

text.content:
Chen Ji's thought moved, and the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment spun rapidly, a hazy light shrouding his entire being. That wave of consciousness swept over him, like tidewater flowing past a reef, yet found nothing unusual.

"Oh? Disappeared?" The voice carried a hint of playfulness, "Interesting... the thing you carry is far more fascinating than I imagined."

After a moment, the consciousness pressure receded like the tide, and deathly silence returned to the cave dwelling. Chen Ji gasped for breath, cold sweat soaking his entire body. He knew the other had only temporarily spared him, but this only raised a terrifying thought in his heart—

Could this existence that surveyed all life from the chessboard have been deliberately guiding him from the very beginning?

choices.description: Surface weakness, but actually seize the opportunity to probe the enemy's true strength, secretly laying out a counterattack
choices.visible_cost: May be regarded as an abandoned piece and lose attention
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information, laying the groundwork for counterattack
choices.risk_hint: If seen through, it will completely infuriate the opponent

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly收敛全身气息，识海中浮现出一抹惶恐的神情。His voice trembled: "Senior... Senior, what eminent name might you have? This junior is merely a insignificant servant disciple..."

The voice fell silent for a moment, then erupted into low laughter: "A servant disciple? A servant disciple protected by the Heavenly Secrets Sword?"

Chen Ji冷笑，but his surface grew even more respectful: "Senior, you jest. How could this junior possibly deserve something as noble as the Heavenly Secrets Sword... It's merely some worthless scrap metal passed down from my ancestors."

He deliberately suppressed his spiritual sense fluctuations to the extreme, revealing an appearance of being at someone's mercy. Meanwhile, deep in his consciousness, the Tianji Record Fragment was rapidly operating, recording every trace of this consciousness's fluctuations.

"Interesting..." the voice spoke again, "This chess piece of mine seems far more cunning than I imagined."

Just then, Chen Ji caught a crucial piece of information — within the depths of that consciousness, there was an extremely faint restriction fluctuation. It was a certain seal's trace, incredibly ancient, seemingly connected to the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment.

His heart shook. A wild thought emerged: Could this ultimate chess player... also be trapped within some kind of chess game?

"I'll remember you." the voice finally said, "I hope that when we meet again, you can bring me more surprises."

The consciousness pressure receded like the tide.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, discovering he had collapsed onto the ground.

The Heavenly Secrets Sword flew back to his dantian, the runes on its surface brighter than before. And on the Tianji Record Fragment, a line of never-before-seen text was slowly emerging —

"Tianji Trial, First Stage: Observe the Chess Player."

A meaningful smile curved his lips: "So that's how it is... This isn't a simple pursuit, but a trial."

Regardless of the choice made, at this moment, Chen Ji clearly realized one thing — from now on, he would no longer be a chess player hiding in the shadows.

He had officially entered the field of vision of that eye overlooking the chessboard.

This was both crisis and opportunity.

Outside the cave, the night remained deep. But at Chen Ji's brow center, an ancient mark that had never appeared before was slowly emerging, like a giant beast dormant for a thousand years opening its drowsy eyes.

The mark emanated a faint glow, resonating with the Heavenly Secrets Sword's runes, as if recounting some bygone tale sealed by dust.

Just then, an aged yet familiar voice rang out in his mind — it was Mo Xiansheng, that mysterious existence that had always existed as a remnant soul on the first page of the Tianji Record.

"Boy... you've gotten yourself into serious trouble."

Mo Xiansheng's voice carried rare gravity: "However, you did better than I anticipated. That restriction fluctuation information... is extremely crucial."

He paused, his tone becoming profound: "It seems you've drawn another step closer to the truth of the Tianji Record."

Chen Ji slowly stood up, wiping the blood from his face, his gaze profound as an abyss.

He gazed into the void, as if wanting to pierce through layers of obstacles to see that eye said to exist in legend.

"Cang Yutian..." he whispered, a dangerous arc curving at the corner of his lips, "You call me a chess piece?"

"Then I'll flip this chessboard and show you."

As his words fell, the ancient mark at his brow center erupted with brilliant light, and that existence dormant for a thousand years seemed truly about to awaken at this very moment.

Just as the light erupted, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power surge from the mark, rushing through his meridians like the Yangtze River.

The power was ancient and vast, carrying a trace of... familiar energy.

"This is..."

His pupils constricted sharply.

Within that chaotic light, he vaguely glimpsed a blurry figure. That figure had its back turned to him, yet carried an indescribable intimacy, as if it were a blood-related kin.

"Ji... er..."

A distant voice arrived, as if traversing endless years.

Chen Ji's body trembled — that was the voice of his father, whom he had never met!

However, just as that voice was about to speak more, a sharp sword qi descended from the heavens, slashing that figure into fragments.

"No—!"

Chen Ji cried out involuntarily, instinctively reaching toward that figure, but only grasping at虚无.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying unprecedented solemnity: "Calm down! That was merely residual obsession... The true key lies with the owner of that sword qi."

Chen Ji猛然抬头, eyes flashing a frigid killing intent: "Who?"

Mo Xiansheng沉默片刻, slowly uttering a name: "Cang Yutian."

Chen Ji's entire aura changed dramatically.

The original carefree expression vanished, replaced by a chilling indifference that sent chills through the heart. He slowly raised his hand, gazing at the strand of his father's energy still lingering in his palm, word by word:

"Cang Yutian..."

"I, Chen Ji, swear to the heavens —"

"I will definitely kill you."

The Heavenly Secrets Sword rang in response, as if echoing his oath. The runes on its surface flickered madly, a startling sword intent shooting straight into the clouds, shaking the entire Tianqing Sect with this sword intent.

In the distance, countless gazes turned toward the Rear Mountain Forbidden Land.

In the Tianqing Sect Inner Sect, Su Qingyao, who had been in seclusion, abruptly opened her eyes, beautiful eyes flickering with complex emotions: "This aura... it's Chen Ji?"

In the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, the old Sect Master Ling Yuan, who had been in meditation, slowly opened his eyes, his turbid eyes flashing a gleam of sharpness.

"The Heavenly Secrets Sword... finally showing activity."

He murmured to himself, a meaningful smile curving his lips: "Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, you're far more interesting than this old man anticipated."

He stood up, gazing toward the Rear Mountain direction: "However, the more you grow, the more interesting you become... because only a plump prey makes for a more satisfying slaughter."

His smile appeared especially eerie in the flickering candlelight.

Meanwhile, in a mysterious space thousands of miles away.

A giant eye woven from countless Heavenly Dao laws floated in the void, its depths flowing with countless scenes — that was the fate of countless people, the rise and fall of countless forces, the interweaving of countless causes and effects.

And at the core of the giant eye, a blurry figure sat cross-legged, surrounded by countless fate threads.

"Interesting..."

The figure slowly spoke, the voice exactly the one that had resonated in Chen Ji's Mental Sea — the Ultimate Chess Player, Cang Yutian.

"The thing on that chess piece is far more troublesome than I anticipated."

Cang Yutian's voice carried no emotional波动 whatsoever, as if stating a fact unrelated to himself.

"Chen Xuan's legacy... and that woman's bloodline..."

He extended a palm composed of laws, gently slicing through the void. An image emerged — that was Chen Ji's face, wrapped by countless fate threads, among which one glowed with blinding golden light.

"Heavenly Fate Lock Key..."

His lips curved into a meaningful smile: "It seems it's time to accelerate the schedule."

As his words fell, countless fate threads began trembling madly, and the entire chessboard's configuration was quietly changing.

Scene returns to the Tianqing Sect Rear Mountain.

Chen Ji slowly收敛气息, the Heavenly Secrets Sword sinking back into his dantian, the ancient mark at his brow center gradually fading away. But he knew this was merely temporary peace.

That father's residual obsession from just now, and that sword qi that shattered the obsession... this information was rapidly integrating in his mind.

"Cang Yutian..." he once again spoke this name, eyes flashing cold light, "You severed my final thread of connection with my father."

"This karmic debt, I've recorded it."

He turned to gaze at the gradually brightening horizon outside the cave, a dangerous arc curving at the corner of his lips: "Since you want to play chess, then I'll play with you."

"However — the outcome of this game, I'll decide."

At the horizon, the first light of dawn pierced through the clouds, spilling onto this land tempered by blood and fire.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, feeling the newborn power within his body. The Heavenly Secrets Sword's runes were brighter than before, and the text on the Tianji Record Fragment was clearer than before.

Although this direct confrontation with the Ultimate Chess Player had cost him dearly, it also granted him crucial information —

That eye overlooking the chessboard was not unshakeable.

Behind that restriction fluctuation lay a secret capable of shaking the entire chess game.

And he would personally excavate that secret.

"Next stage..." Chen Ji whispered, his gaze casting toward the distance, "It's my turn to counterattack."

Just then, a light footstep sounded outside the cave.

Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly, and he turned to look — a white-robed figure stood at the cave entrance, backlit, cold eyes tightly fixed on him.

Su Qingyao.

Her appearance caused Chen Ji's heart to tighten slightly. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow was the greatest variable in his grand scheme — she was the only one who had sensed he was no ordinary person.

And now, it seemed she had sensed something again.

"Chen Ji." Su Qingyao's voice was cold as frost, "That sword intent from just now — did you emit it?"

She took a step forward, beautiful eyes flashing with scrutiny: "What exactly... are you hiding?"
